title: God as Terminal Ground of Logic, Identity, Relation, and Measure
claim: Science presupposes identity, noncontradiction, quantity, relation, measurement, and valid inference. God, under the Christian Logos claim, does not presuppose those structures as an external authority over Him; rather, God is the terminal ground whose rational nature is expressed through identity, noncontradiction, intelligibility, measure, relation, and truth. Science and God therefore touch the same truth-order differently: science depends on it and cannot terminate it, while God terminates the grounding chain as the personal Logos.
assumptions: Science depends on logic, identity, noncontradiction, quantity, relation, measurement, and valid inference.
Science does not terminate the grounding chain for those preconditions because it already uses them.
The Christian Logos claim identifies God as rational, truthful, non-self-contradictory, personal, and terminally grounding.
Logical and mathematical order are not external constraints imposed above God in classical Christian theism.
definitions: Presupposition relation: a downstream practice depends on a structure it must already use.
Terminal grounding relation: the explanatory chain stops at the ground rather than continuing to a deeper dependency.
Logos grounding: the claim that rational order, intelligibility, truth, and relation are grounded in God's nature.
equations: science -> presupposes(identity + noncontradiction + quantity + relation + measurement + valid_inference)
Christian Logos claim -> God grounds(identity + noncontradiction + intelligibility + relation + truth)
God = terminal ground under the Christian Logos bundle
bridges: morality expresses personal and normative order
negative_guards: Do not say God presupposes logic in the same downstream way science does.
Do not say logic is an external authority above God.
Do not reduce God to impersonal mathematics or abstract logic.
Do not call this a completed proof of Christianity without the Christian Logos bundle being tested.
Do not erase the difference between impersonal formal structure and personal divine ground.
kill_conditions: The Christian Logos bundle fails to justify God as terminal ground rather than one item inside the order.
A rival grounding account explains identity, noncontradiction, quantity, relation, measurement, valid inference, morality, and no drift with fewer unresolved commitments.
The bridge collapses God into impersonal abstraction rather than preserving divine personhood.
The distinction between presupposing and grounding cannot be maintained under review.
